SELECT d.*
                          FROM public.marketplace_transaction_identity_decision d
     WHERE d.organization_id=p_organization_id
       AND d.decision_id=p_decision_id

existing.intent_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM stored_intent
           OR existing.decision_semantic_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM stored_semantic

p_intent_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM proposed_intent
           OR existing.intent_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM proposed_intent

SELECT count(*)
                                    FROM public.command_authority_operation o
     WHERE o.organization_id=p_organization_id
       AND o.operation='GRANT'
       AND o.principal_id=p_principal_id
       AND o.grant_id=p_grant_id
       AND o.grant_revision=p_grant_revision
       AND o.permission='TRANSACTION_IDENTITY_DECISION_WRITE'
       AND o.state='ENABLED'
       AND o.attestation_manifest_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT o.*
                                         FROM public.command_authority_operation o
     WHERE o.organization_id=p_organization_id
       AND o.operation='GRANT'
       AND o.principal_id=p_principal_id
       AND o.grant_id=p_grant_id
       AND o.grant_revision=p_grant_revision
       AND o.permission='TRANSACTION_IDENTITY_DECISION_WRITE'
       AND o.state='ENABLED'
       AND o.attestation_manifest_id IS NOT NULL

linked_operation.attestation_manifest_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_claim_manifest_id
       OR p_claim_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_organization_id

SELECT a.*
                          FROM public.s2a_accepted_attestation a
     WHERE a.organization_id=p_organization_id
       AND a.manifest_id=linked_operation.attestation_manifest_id
